hero.filename: Railroad yards in Kearney, New Jersey.jpg
hero.title: File:Railroad yards in Kearney, New Jersey.jpg
hero.artist: Doc Searls from Santa Barbara, USA
hero.source: Railroad yards in Kearney, New Jersey
hero.description: CSX South Kearny rail yard, New Jersey, with the black Pulaski Skyway (highways 1 and 9) cutting across the meadowlands below the southern Manhattan skyline, dominated by the new One World Trade Center. The New Jersey Turnpike is in the foreground, crossing the Passaic River. The Hackensack is the other river farther out. They join just offscreen to the right. The rail line on the far left, running under the Turnpike, is the Amtrak Northeast Corridor.
